name: Innuovo Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Innuovo Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, sale, import, and export of rare earth permanent magnet materials in China and internationally. The company also engages in motor manufacturing, such as alternating current motors, permanent magnet, DC motors, brushless, steppers, servo motors, electric push rod actuators, parallel shafts, worm gears, and planetary gear reducers, as well as motor drives and mobility scooters. In addition, it offers gearboxes, electrical machinery equipment, general and special equipment, communication equipment, computers, and other electronic equipment; and electric wheelchairs.
